project_info.theme: Confident black-and-red evening editorial in an old European alley
project_info.color_palette: grayscale stone, deep black, saturated red, warm streetlight

main_subject.detail: An adult woman with a curvy feminine silhouette and long dark glossy hair in soft voluminous waves stands on a narrow stone stairway. She wears a fitted black evening dress with a refined open-back detail, long black gloves, sheer black stockings, and glossy red high heels. A realistic red-rose tattoo is visible across the upper shoulder blade. Her makeup has defined eyes, sharp eyeliner, deep red lips, and natural skin texture.

items: full-body vertical composition on a narrow urban stairway between old city buildings
poised three-quarter stance with one foot slightly forward and shoulders relaxed
head turns back toward camera with a calm self-assured expression
bright red umbrella open above her as the primary color contrast
old European alley with balconies and stone walls fading into a controlled depth-of-field blur

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: soft ambient city light with subtle directional rim light
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: directional light highlights shoulders and the fitted dress silhouette, with natural shadows shaping the stairs and fabric texture

technical_specs.color_treatment: restrained grayscale city tones contrasted with rich blacks and saturated red, natural skin texture, crisp fabric detail

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a full-body cinematic fashion editorial of an adult woman standing confidently on a narrow urban stairway between old European city buildings. She has a curvy feminine silhouette, long dark glossy hair in soft voluminous waves, defined eyes, sharp eyeliner, deep red lips, and natural skin texture. Dress her in a fitted black evening dress with a refined open-back detail, long black gloves, sheer black stockings, and glossy red high heels. Show a realistic red-rose tattoo across the upper shoulder blade. Pose her in a poised three-quarter stance with one foot slightly forward and shoulders relaxed, turning her head back toward the camera with a calm self-assured expression. She holds a bright red umbrella open above her. Use soft ambient city light and a subtle directional rim light to highlight shoulders and the fitted dress silhouette, with natural shadows across the stone steps. Keep the old alley, balconies, and stone walls readable but softly blurred behind her. Use grayscale city tones contrasted with deep reds and rich blacks for a bold, elegant, dark-romantic editorial image.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, body-targeted framing, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: If supplied, use an approved adult face reference and preserve its facial structure, proportions, features, and expression. Preserve the black fitted evening dress, red-rose shoulder tattoo, black gloves, sheer stockings, red heels, red umbrella, stairway, back-glance pose, and dark-romantic city mood. Do not use celebrity/public-figure likeness.
